String Studio uses these unmodified, separately replaceable image decoders.
They load locally only when the browser cannot decode TIFF or HEIC/HEIF.

UTIF.js 3.1.0 - MIT
Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea
License: utif-LICENSE.txt
Source: https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js

pako 1.0.11 - MIT and Zlib
Copyright (c) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn
License: pako-LICENSE.txt
Source: https://github.com/nodeca/pako/tree/1.0.11

heic-to 1.6.5 - LGPL-3.0-or-later
License: heic-to-LICENSE.txt
Source and build instructions: heic-source/README.md
Complete upstream source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.5
The wrapper sources and its build script are also provided in heic-source/.
The bundled libheif 1.23.5 source is available at:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.5
Its libde265 1.0.16 dependency source is available at:
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16

These libraries may be replaced or modified under their respective licenses.
String Studio does not restrict reverse engineering for debugging changes to
the LGPL library. Keep these notices and licenses with redistributed copies.
The GNU GPL v3 text incorporated by the LGPL is included as GPL-3.0.txt.
